([[Bel Aire, Kansas]]) | college = [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]] (2022–2023) | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 37 | draft_team = [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] | career_start = 2019 | years1 = 2019–2021 | team1 = RIG Mark Kinna | years2 = 2021 | team2 = [[Borås Basket]] | years3 = 2023–2024 | team3 = [[Cairns Taipans]] | years4 = {{nbay|2024|start}}–{{nbay|2025|end}} | team4 = [[Detroit Pistons]] | years5 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]]–[[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team5 = →[[Motor City Cruise]] | years6 = 2026–present | team6 = [[Virtus Bologna]] | highlights = }} '''Bobi Klintman''' (born 6 March 2003) is a Swedish professional [[basketball]] player for [[Virtus Bologna]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA) and the [[EuroLeague]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest Demon Deacons]]. He was drafted by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in the second round of the [[2024 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and high school career== Klintman was born in [[Malmö]], Sweden, to a Swedish mother and a father from [[Senegal]].{{cite web |title=Bobi Klintman Q&A |url=https://www.prospectiveinsight.com/post/bobi-klintman |website=Prospective Insight |access-date=26 July 2023 |language=English |date=11 Jun 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/snakes-strike-to-sign-next-star|title=Snakes Strike to Sign Next Star|website=NBL.com.au|date=13 June 2023|access-date=13 June 2023}} He attended Sweden's RIG Mark Academy in [[Kinna]].{{cite web|url=https://kansas.rivals.com/news/maryland-basketball-lands-commitment-from-swedish-three-star-wing|title=Maryland basketball lands commitment from Swedish three-star wing|first=Scott|last=Greene|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=13 October 2021|access-date=26 May 2023}} In the 2019–20 season, he played 13 games for RIG Mark in the third-tier [[Basketettan]].{{cite web|url=https://basketball.usbasket.com/player/Bo-Klintman/502029|title=Bo Klintman|work=usbasket.com|access-date=13 June 2023|url-access=subscription}} He continued with RIG Mark in the second-tier [[Superettan (basketball)|Superettan]] in 2020–21 before the season was cancelled in February 2021 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://netscoutsbasketball.com/blog/meeting-top-international-prospects-bobi-klintman/|title=Meeting Top International Prospects: Bobi Klintman|first=Carl|last=Berman|website=netscoutsbasketball.com|date=9 March 2021|access-date=13 June 2023}} He played six games for [[Borås Basket]] in the first-tier [[Swedish Basketball League|Basketligan]] to finish the season. Klintman enrolled at Sunrise Christian Academy in [[Bel Aire, Kansas]], for the 2021–22 U.S. high school year.{{Cite web |date=6 September 2021 |title=Recruit Bobi Klintman has KU basketball on list of 6 schools |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article254030063.html |access-date=19 April 2023 |website=[[The Kansas City Star]]}} He was rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and initially committed to playing college basketball for [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]].{{cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2021/10/13/bobi-klintman-maryland-basketball-recruit/|title=Maryland men's basketball lands four-star Bobi Klintman as first recruit in 2022 class|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|date=13 October 2021|access-date=26 May 2023}} He later decommitted from Maryland and committed to play for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]].{{cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/college/colorado-buffaloes/news/4-star-sf-bobi-klintman-commits-to-colorado/|title=4-star SF Bobi Klintman commits to Colorado|first=Joe|last=Tipton|website=On3.com|date=14 April 2022|access-date=26 May 2023}} Klintman decommitted a second time and ultimately signed to play for [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Article/4-star-forward-Bobi-Klintman-commits-to-Wake-Forest-former-Colorado-and-Maryland-commit-2022-basketball-recruiting-187523812/|title=Top150 prospect Bobi Klintman commits to Wake Forest|first=Travis|last=Branham|website=[[247Sports]]|date=13 May 2022|access-date=10 April 2023}} ==College career== As a freshman in the [[2022–23 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|2022–23 season]], Klintman played in 33 games with five starts and averaged 5.3 points and 4.5 rebounds in 20.5 minutes per game for the [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest Demon Deacons]].{{Cite web |title=Bobi Klintman College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/bobi-klintman-1.html |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} Klintman initially declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]]{{cite web|url=https://wakeforest.rivals.com/news/bobi-klintman-to-enter-nba-draft-while-maintaining-eligibility|title=Bobi Klintman to enter NBA draft while maintaining eligibility|first=Conor|last=O'Neill|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=6 April 2023|access-date=19 April 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4382121/2023/04/06/bobi-klintman-nba-draft/|title=Why Bobi Klintman could be NBA Draft's mystery man — and why his declaration is so interesting|first=Sam|last=Vecenie|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=6 April 2023|access-date=10 April 2023}} and later informed Wake Forest that he would not return to the team for the 2023–24 season.{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2023/05/15/wake-forest-bobi-klintman-nba-draft-combine-promise/|title=Report: Wake Forest's Bobi Klintman has withdrawn from the draft combine|first=Cody|last=Taylor|website=Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=15 May 2023|access-date=26 May 2023}} ==Professional career== On 13 June 2023, Klintman signed with the [[Cairns Taipans]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL), joining the team as part of the league's ''Next Stars'' program for the [[2023–24 NBL season|2023–24 season]].{{cite web|url=https://www.taipans.com/news/taipans-secure-swedish-sensation|title=TAIPANS SECURE SWEDISH SENSATION|website=Taipans.com|date=13 June 2023|access-date=13 June 2023}} On 27 June 2024, Klintman was selected with the 37th overall pick by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]]. However, he was traded to the [[Detroit Pistons]] along with [[Wendell Moore Jr.]] for the 53rd overall pick in the 2024 draft.{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Acquire a Future Draft Pick and Cash Considerations|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-acquire-a-future-draft-pick-and-cash-considerations|website=NBA.com|date=July 6, 2024|access-date=July 7, 2024}} On July 13, he signed with the Pistons.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Pistons Sign Bobi Klintman To Four-Year Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/07/pistons-to-sign-bobi-klintman-to-four-year-deal.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=July 13, 2024|access-date=July 13, 2024}} Throughout his rookie season, he was [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] several times to the [[Motor City Cruise]].{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Motor City Cruise Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Motor-City-Cruise/62/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 18, 2024}} Klintman made 12 appearances for Detroit during the [[2025–26 NBA season]], recording averages of 1.8 points, 1.6 rebounds, and 0.5 assists. On 7 April 2026, he was waived by the Pistons after [[Tolu Smith]] was signed to a standard contract.{{Cite web|title=Pistons sign two-way center Tolu Smith to roster, wave Bobi Klintman|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2026/04/07/pistons-nba-roster-tolu-smith-bobi-klintman/89504891007/|access-date=April 17, 2026|website=freep.com|language=en}} On July 2, 2026, Klintman signed with [[Virtus Bologna]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A|LBA]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/bobi-klintman-signs-multi-year-deal-at-virtus/|title=Bobi Klintman signs multi-year deal at Virtus|date=July 2, 2026|website=euroleaguebasketball.net|access-date=July 2, 2026}} ==National team career== Klintman played for the Sweden men's national under-18 basketball team in Finland in the Nordic championships where they won the gold medal. Klintman played for the [[Sweden men's national under-20 basketball team|Sweden under-20 basketball team]] in the [[2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]].{{cite web|url=https://www.bloggersodear.com/2022/7/24/23276336/bobi-klintman-dominates-at-fiba-u20-championship-wake-forest-wfu-deacs-demon-deacons|title=Bobi Klintman Dominates at FIBA U20 Championship|first=Adam|last=Bridgers|website=BloggerSoDear.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=24 July 2022|access-date=13 May 2023}} He was selected for the All-Star team.{{citation needed|date=July
